args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Bump the pin
to 2.9.4, the first fixed 2.x release, to stay on the current major
version line.

args.body:
## Summary
Bumps the `fastjson` pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson < 2.9.4 is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the first fixed release on the 2.x line, so this stays on the current major version and avoids a risky jump to 3.x.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` -> `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

cc @alex for review (code owner approval required to merge into main).
